question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Melancholy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pleasant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"melancholy"** means a deep, pensive, and long-lasting sadness. (उदासी)

 
 
• **Example: **After the loss of his pet, he was in a state of melancholy for weeks.
 
 
 
• **"Pleasant"** refers to something that is enjoyable, pleasing, or giving a sense of happy satisfaction. (सुखद)
 
 
• **Example: **The weather today is very pleasant, perfect for a walk in the park.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'melancholy'** is **'pleasant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pleasant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Miserable **(दुखी): Extremely unhappy or uncomfortable.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt miserable when she heard the bad news.
 
 
 
• **Profitable **(लाभदायक): Yielding profit or financial gain.
 
 
• **Example: **The new business venture turned out to be very profitable.
 
 
 
• **Mechanical** (यांत्रिक): Operated by machinery or relating to machines.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a mechanical approach to solving problems, often lacking creativity.
